title: Purple Sorceress
description: A female character with light purple hair and purple eyes stands in a dynamic pose against a solid dark gray background. She wears a white and purple traditional outfit with intricate patterns, wields a glowing purple crescent moon staff in her right hand, and holds a swirling purple orb of magical energy in her left hand, with crackling purple energy emanating from her headpiece.
prompt: A young East Asian female sorceress with long flowing light purple hair and purple eyes, wearing an ornate white and purple traditional fantasy outfit with a corset top and flowing sleeves, stands in a combat pose. She holds a glowing purple crescent moon staff in one hand and casts a swirling purple energy orb with the other. A spiky purple magical crown floats above her head with crackling energy. Clean solid dark gray background, highly detailed digital illustration style.
